name: kernel-forge-aws-transform
description: Migrate PyTorch and Triton kernels to AWS Trainium NKI. Converts nn.Module.forward and @triton.jit kernels into @nki.jit kernels, then compiles, numerically verifies, and profiles every candidate on a real Trainium device before emitting a diff.

interface.shortDescription: Migrate PyTorch and Triton kernels to AWS Trainium NKI, verified on real silicon.
interface.longDescription: Converts PyTorch nn.Module and @triton.jit kernels (and hand-written CUDA custom kernels) into @nki.jit kernels for AWS Trainium and Inferentia. Every candidate is compiled with neuronx-cc, numerically verified against the PyTorch reference with np.allclose, and profiled against the baseline on a real Trainium device before a diff is emitted. Two human gates: you pick the kernels and model backend (Scope), then sign off the accuracy and performance budget (Requirements).
defaultPrompt: Convert this Triton softmax kernel to NKI for Trainium.
Find the hot kernels in this repo and migrate them to NKI.
Rewrite this CUDA RMSNorm kernel for Inferentia and verify it on device.
